subject.title: [Feature]: Visible agent-to-agent messaging for ACP thread-bound sessions (proxy-only delivery without main session creation)

question: Which visible ACP-thread delivery contract should OpenClaw support for coordinator-to-worker instructions without creating main Discord session metadata?
rationale: The code can support multiple shapes, but the choice changes public API semantics, session metadata behavior, and Discord authorization boundaries.

options.title: Define Narrow Visible ACP Send
options.body: Add an explicit sessions_send-style visible mode scoped to authorized ACP-bound sessions and prove it avoids unintended main-session metadata.

options.title: Define Proxy-Only Message Send
options.body: Add a message/gateway send bypass for authorized proxy delivery while preserving normal outbound mirroring everywhere else.

options.title: Decline Core API Change
options.body: Keep this in plugin/community space and document that current plugin workarounds cannot bypass main-session metadata without a future core seam.

recommendation.title: Define Narrow Visible ACP Send
recommendation.body: Add an explicit sessions_send-style visible mode scoped to authorized ACP-bound sessions and prove it avoids unintended main-session metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history place the central tool, protocol, and outbound metadata surfaces under this routing path.
